instruction: The precondition file is saved at /home/user/Precondition_Unnamed.FCStd. Open that file; it contains the base part shown in the before image and sketch(es) you will need. Build the target shape shown in the after image by adding the remaining pocket, mirror, and fillet operations. Use Sketch006 to create a through-all Pocket, cutting in the reversed direction. Mirror the resulting feature set across the supplied Sketch006 mirror plane as shown. Add the final fillet with radius 10 mm. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
